summary: Fixed review B flow-B4 (with owner decision OD15), flow-B6, flow-B8, flow-B9, flow-B11, flow-B12 and flow-B13, each reproduced first by a test that failed on 001050c and passes after. OD15: with no pick, Better is the implied pick; a recommended option that is not shown moves to the shown option doing the same work (the engine now marks it on PricedOption.sameWorkAs), else the nearest shown above, else below. Every headline caller (phone dock, cards and list, Send step, office list, sync model_total_price, quote recommendedTier, the checker) goes through lib/field/recommended.ts. Golden sets re-priced from the existing read-only export: no headline changes (both byte-identical to after-fixa); random quotes 24/10,000, 50/20,000, 42/20,000 headlines move, all no pick, Good -> Best (docs/accuracy/after-fixb/headline-changes.txt). Checks: typecheck, lint, 1,665 vitest tests, violations 0 at seeds 20261118, 7 and 99999, and one full e2e run (341 checks, console errors: none) with a new 'review B screens' step.

fixed.what: lib/field/recommended.ts: no pick (or no tier) = Better as the implied pick; a pick not shown goes to options.find(o => o.sameWorkAs includes it), else the nearest shown above, else the nearest below, else the first. lib/pricing/engine.ts shownOptions marks the kept option of each same-work pair (PricedOption.sameWorkAs, transitive; computed in showAll too so shown and showAll options stay deep-equal). The ledger's L9 wording is amended and RB-flow-B4 added. Callers checked: app/field/EstimateEditor.tsx (dock, phone list summary), OptionsStep, SendStep, lib/office/estimates.ts headlinePrice, lib/sync/payload.ts model_total_price, lib/quotes/model.ts recommendedTier, lib/quotes/invariants.ts expectedHeadline/headlineTexts: all call recommendedTier. The office list and the checker see stored tier/price only, so they take the nearest-above step without the same-work step; that names the same option in every golden, production-stored and random quote checked (0 differing in 50,000).

ownerQuestions: OD15 says what happens when Better is hidden. The same rule (a hidden pick moves to the shown option doing the same work, else the nearest above, else below) is applied to a hidden Good or Best pick too, so one rule covers every pick; in every golden and random quote checked it names the same option the old 'next shown after the pick' rule did. Keep it general, or apply the same-work step to Better only?

flow-B9: a cost confirmed with 'This cost is right' now widens the stored usual range for good (e.g. $0.06-$0.30), so later typos up to that cost are no longer caught. Is that what you want, or should the confirmation only stick for that exact cost?
